title: Barua Rasmi (Theme 4: Misimu)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child places the parts of an official letter: the writer's address on the right, the date, the receiver's address on the left, the formal greeting, KUH:, the message, Wako mtiifu, the signature and full name.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the parts of a friendly letter.
floor.question: Barua ya kirafiki ina anwani ngapi?

representations: part cards for a blank page
steps: Write the writer's address and date.
contexts: seasons (misimu): a letter to the county about rain damage
a letter to the head teacher

board.say: Sehemu hii inaitwaje na inafanya kazi gani?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child orders the part cards on a blank page.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mada ya barua rasmi huandikwa katika ___ cha barua." Kwa nini "mwili" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kichwa hutaja mada, salamu humwamkia mwandikiwa, mwili una ujumbe, na mwisho una sahihi na jina.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Anwani ya mwandikaji wa barua rasmi huandikwa upande wa ___ juu ya karatasi." Kwa nini "kushoto" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Anwani ya mwandikaji iko juu kulia. Anwani ya mwandikiwa iko kushoto, chini ya tarehe.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Mwisho wa barua rasmi huwa "Wako ___,"." Kwa nini "mpenzi" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha na maneno ya heshima, kama "Wako mwaminifu,".

listen_for: Salamu, mwili, anwani, kichwa, tarehe, mwisho
misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni mpangilio upi sahihi wa sehemu za barua rasmi?" Kwa nini "Salamu, mwili, anwani, kichwa, tarehe, mwisho" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Barua huanza na anwani na tarehe juu, kisha salamu, kichwa, mwili na mwisho chini.

checks.question: Barua rasmi humalizika kwa?
checks.answer: Wako mtiifu, sahihi na jina kamili

skills.key_step: The child plans barua rasmi before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Ombi la Kupanda Miti Shuleni".

misconceptions.ask: Barua hii itamfikia nani? Anwani yake iko wapi?
misconceptions.repair: Barua rasmi ina anwani mbili: ya mwandishi kulia juu, ya mpokeaji kushoto chini yake.

listen_for: Nimeandika barua hii kwa sababu ninataka kukueleza mambo mengi.
misconceptions.ask: Msomaji atajuaje barua inahusu nini bila kuisoma yote?
misconceptions.repair: Kichwa cha barua rasmi huanza KUH: au YAH: na huandikwa kwa herufi kubwa, kwa ufupi.

misconceptions.ask: Ungemsalimu Mwalimu Mkuu hivi katika mkutano rasmi?
misconceptions.repair: Barua rasmi hutumia lugha rasmi: Kwa Mwalimu Mkuu, Wako mtiifu.

misconceptions.ask: Mpokeaji atajuaje ni nani hasa aliyeandika?
misconceptions.repair: Barua rasmi humalizika kwa "Wako mtiifu," sahihi na jina kamili.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika barua rasmi kuhusu "Ombi la Kupanda Miti Shuleni"?
Barua rasmi ina sehemu zipi?
checks.answer: anwani au kichwa, salamu, ujumbe, hitimisho
